display_name: 南美五国矿业法规与新闻动态
applies_to: Group selection/presentation after the existing unified intake and processing; adapt to current repository contracts.
country_disambiguation: 法属圭亚那/French Guiana is not Guyana.
Guayana may name a wider region; require country context.
Do not stamp all five country codes on every item from a global source.
include_topics: 矿权、矿业许可与正规化
勘探、开发、投产、停产和矿业项目进展
矿业相关税收、海关、外汇和投资制度
环境、安全、用工、社区与非法采矿
对五国矿业经营有明确影响的电力、交通、公共卫生与政治事件
applicability_evidence: Article/document directly concerns a target country or project.
A broader rule or development has documented, explainable applicability to target-country mining operations.
intake_rule: Reuse current mining information intake rules. Concrete mining/industry information need not first qualify as major news. Do not change existing scoring thresholds or selected/hot rules.
global_sources: Keep global/China sources in the shared source inventory; apply target-country applicability at group selection, not by publisher headquarters or language.

edge_sources.handling: Retain requested sources. Ordinary off-region coal, election or health news is outside this group unless applicability to target-country mining is evidenced.

law_state: Keep draft/introduced/passed/promulgated/effective states distinct. Media summaries require a legal original when reporting legal effect.
deduplication: Preserve source IDs and runtime manual state.
Same publisher across feeds/sections/languages is not automatically independent corroboration.
Use current event grouping, source ownership and information-increment rules; no new voting formula.
Shared government hosts need institution-level identity.
source_dates: Preserve original raw date and precision. Do not fill timezone from the publisher country; never replace missing dates with fetch time.

rights_defaults.note: Existing source permissions remain governed by the repository; the package itself does not modify them.

delivery: No recipient, webhook, token, schedule or actual group-message delivery is configured by this package.
